about: The repeated Lipitor and Crestor supplies fall within 60 days of each other and identify two different statins by brand, raising possible duplication.
Norspan patches and tramadol capsules are supplied for pain on dates one day apart, with no recorded switch or guideline-supported reason for the pair.
Atorvastatin stopped before rosuvastatin began, Buvidal Weekly is for opioid dependence, and Ventolin with Seretide is the excluded short-acting and long-acting beta-2 agonist pair.
